audio_music: An upbeat, classic 1970s disco-pop song ('More Than A Woman' by the Bee Gees) plays throughout the video. The cheerful and romantic tone of the music creates a sarcastic or mocking contrast with the political subject matter, especially when showing the faces of politicians who voted against the bill.

cultural_references: The song 'More Than A Woman' by the Bee Gees, famously featured in the movie 'Saturday Night Fever'.
central_claim: Democrats passed a popular bill to cap insulin costs at $35/month, but 193 House Republicans voted against it.
intended_effect: To generate approval for Democrats and portray Republicans as obstacles to affordable healthcare, thereby encouraging viewers to support Democrats.
